limits: No runtime execution/accounts/media/devices, no successful external playback claim.
Jellyfin owns its media server; transcoding/remux failover does not restore closed outside publishers.
Media helper uses module-global recovery dates and a restart branch; do not copy policy as a strict per-attempt budget.

discoveryExtension.evidence: Existing shipped main bundle; same REA module68221. Guide source separately reviewed; no new producer.

entryFlow.mechanism: Program.Id is not the playback object. Program.ChannelId resolves exact channel item through getItemsForPlayback.
Program requires explicit StartDate and EndDate and current interval for canPlay; this is time eligibility, not live-video proof.
Playback information is negotiated with ItemId, MediaSourceId, LiveStreamId and DeviceProfile; read-only information and actual IsPlayback/AutoOpenLiveStream are explicit.
RequiresOpening without LiveStreamId obtains a live stream through LiveStreams/Open; selected media is rechecked for direct-play capabilities.

mechanisms: Fetch known channels first, then overlapping programmes with explicit channelIds.
Guide refresh15min while active; pause/destroy cancel interval.
guideSource.limits: Guide source was not added to REA producer; current-time eligibility is not verified live programme delivery.

fottyRecommendations: Maintain an independent exact fixture↔provider-advertised-eventID↔delivery binding with source provenance/freshness/expiry and preserve it when a sibling catalog disappears.

Build bounded provider-event indexes from already fetched metadata and join against official fixtures before match detail; refresh advertised descriptors near event windows rather than relying on one master catalog.
Keep explicit states: scheduled programme, provider match, currently advertised compatible source, and decoded playback; generic channel alone does not establish a fixture source.
Never copy Jellyfin channel joins to guessed Willow/Fox sports mappings. Fotty requires verified programme identity before attaching a channel to a named fixture.
discoveryExtension.boundary: Jellyfin controls server/channel identity, tuner credentials, open-stream negotiation and transcoding. Its catalogue cannot supply or guarantee third-party sports streams absent an admitted exact programme/source.
